__comment: DelightfulCompat FIX: oaksdelight 1.0.9 ships NO working recipe for oaksdelight:butter — the file at this path actually produced oaksdelight:muffins (a duplicate of cooking/muffins.json), so butter was uncraftable and every butter-dependent recipe (pancakes, muffins, soft serve) was blocked. This restores a butter recipe: churn milk into butter in the Farmer's Delight Cooking Pot. Balance is a best guess (2 milk -> 1 butter); adjust to taste. Gated so it's inert if Oak's Delight is absent.
